2607.10179.title: From Patent Expiry to Business Pathways: AI Workflows for Activating Innovation Archives
2607.10179.paper_summary: Patent databases represent one of the largest public archives of technical knowledge, yet much of this knowledge remains difficult to identify, interpret, and reuse once patent rights expire or lapse. This paper proposes an AI-enabled framework for discovering expired and lapsing patents, identifying technology trends, and translating patent disclosures into business pathways. We use pathways to mean structured commercialization routes such as SaaS products, services, licensing packages, consulting playbooks, training offerings, data products, or internal process tools. The framework treats patent expiry as both a business signal and an archival transition, not primarily as a legal problem. Legal status remains important, but it is one risk-screening input alongside customer need, implementation feasibility, channel access, and market timing. We describe a system architecture that combines patent metadata, maintenance-fee records, legal-status indicators, semantic search, patent-family analysis, market signals, and generative AI workflows. A proof of concept parses all 378 records in an official weekly CIPO ST.96 archive, identifies 20 expired, lapsed, or near-expiry candidates, tests the stability of the transparent scoring model, and uses a locally hosted Qwen3.6 model to populate structured review packets. The evaluation demonstrates reproducible ingestion, stable rankings under weight perturbation, and schema-conformant model output, while also exposing incomplete legal-status coverage and the need for register and expert review. We argue that AI can function as a discovery and translation layer for dormant technical knowledge, but that such systems must explicitly represent legal uncertainty, data limitations, and commercialization risk.
2607.10179.paper_summary_zh: 專利數據庫代表了最大的公共技術知識檔案之一，然而這些知識在專利權到期或失效後，仍然難以識別、解釋和重用。本文提出了一個基於人工智慧的框架，用於發現已過期和即將過期的專利、識別技術趨勢，以及將專利披露轉化為商業路徑。我們使用“路徑”來指代結構化的商業化路徑，例如SaaS產品、服務、授權包、諮詢手冊、培訓產品、數據產品或內部流程工具。該框架將專利到期視為商業信號和檔案轉換，而不僅僅是法律問題。法律狀態仍然重要，但它只是風險篩選的一個輸入，與客戶需求、實施可行性、渠道接入和市場時機並列。我們描述了一個系統架構，結合了專利元數據、維護費用記錄、法律狀態指標、語義搜索、專利家族分析、市場信號和生成式AI工作流程。概念驗證解析了官方每週CIPO ST.96檔案中的所有378條記錄，識別出20個已過期、失效或接近到期的候選專利，測試透明評分模型的穩定性，並使用本地托管的Qwen3.6模型來填充結構化審查包。評估顯示可重複的數據攝取、在權重擾動下穩定的排名，以及符合架構的模型輸出，同時也暴露了法律狀態覆蓋的不完整性和註冊及專家審查的需求。我們認為，人工智慧可以作為潛在技術知識的發現和轉化層，但這樣的系統必須明確表示法律不確定性、數據限制和商業化風險。
2607.10179.author: Sidney Shapiro et.al.
